title: Private Electric Golf Cart Tour of Tampa with Karaoke
blurb:
Explore Tampa in a unique way aboard a private electric golf cart. This 1.5-hour tour takes you through vibrant neighborhoods, from the scenic waterfront of Harbour Island to the lively streets of Ybor City. With a local guide, you’ll uncover the city’s hidden gems and hear captivating stories while enjoying wireless karaoke with on-screen lyrics. Capture perfect photos at curated stops, ensuring every moment is Instagram-worthy. Perfect for small groups with a maximum of five guests, this tour is ideal for any occasion—birthdays, date nights, or just a fun outing with friends.

- 2-hour guided tour of Tampa’s neighborhoods in a private golf cart
- Wireless karaoke system with full playlist control and mics for every guest
- Curated photo stops at scenic locations for great photo ops
- Small group experience with a maximum of five guests per cart
